risks.title: Intense Market Competition
risks.score_rationale: ACI operates in rapidly changing, highly competitive markets with larger competitors possessing significantly greater financial, technical and marketing resources. Consolidation among competitors and in-house development by clients create ongoing competitive pressures.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection
risks.score_rationale: As a payments infrastructure provider, ACI is exposed to cybersecurity threats, data breaches, and system disruptions. The increasing threat landscape with AI-driven fraud exploits requires continuous investment in security measures.

risks.title: Cloud and Infrastructure Dependencies
risks.score_rationale: ACI increasingly relies on cloud infrastructure partners (AWS, Azure) and strategic technology partners (IBM, Red Hat) for cloud-native solutions delivery. Service disruptions could impact customer operations.

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance Changes
risks.score_rationale: ACI operates in heavily regulated financial services markets. Regulatory changes such as ISO 20022 implementation, stablecoin regulations (GENIUS Act), and evolving payment standards require ongoing solution adaptation.

risks.title: Acquisition Integration Risk
risks.score_rationale: ACI pursues growth through acquisitions and strategic partnerships. Integration challenges could impact financial performance and strategic objectives.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange and Currency Risks
risks.score_rationale: While majority of contracts are USD-denominated, significant portions of sales occur in local currencies, and operational expenses are incurred internationally, creating exposure to currency fluctuations.

risks.title: Customer Concentration and In-House Development
risks.score_rationale: Some existing and potential customers develop key payment solutions in-house, reducing demand for ACI solutions. Customer consolidation in financial services could concentrate revenues.

ai_positioning.summary: ACI Worldwide recognizes the growing importance of AI and advanced analytics in fraud prevention and customer experience enhancement. The company sees opportunities for AI to automate financial protection, including synthetic identity detection and automated remediation, particularly in response to heightened risks from AI agents creating new attack vectors.
evidence: Payments Intelligence and Artificial Intelligence section in MD&A: ACI discusses AI's role in combating fraud, recognizing synthetic identities, and automating financial protection
Recognition that AI will be used both to accelerate vulnerabilities and to automate defense mechanisms
Emphasis on AI-driven solutions for mitigating risks while improving customer experience
